scenes.headline: Westmoreland out-earns St James per night.
scenes.vo: Westmoreland out-earns St James per night on a two-bed holiday let.

scenes.title: Median 2-bed nightly rate (£)
scenes.note: Holiday lets: median nightly rates, 2-bed live listings, Oct 2026. £1 = J$213.
scenes.vo: Westmoreland leads at around a hundred and twenty-nine pounds a night. Kingston and St Ann follow. St James, home of Montego Bay, sits mid-table at ninety-seven.
That's about a hundred and seventy US dollars a night, against a hundred and twenty-eight.

body: Occupancy and purchase price decide the deal.
scenes.vo: But nightly rate is only one input. Occupancy, and what you pay for the property, decide whether the deal works.
